Lingerie OEM from China: How to Source Quality Intimate Apparel at Competitive Prices

A practical guide to finding reliable OEM manufacturers in China's lingerie industry — from Shantou and Zhongshan clusters to quality control and MOQ negotiation.

China's Lingerie Manufacturing Clusters

China's intimate apparel industry is concentrated in several key manufacturing clusters, each with its own strengths:

  • Shantou (Guangdong): The largest lingerie manufacturing base in China, known for lace and seamless underwear. Home to brands like Cosmo Lady and Maniform. Over 2,000 factories with 30+ years of experience.
  • Zhongshan (Guangdong): Specializes in mid-to-high-end bra manufacturing with strong OEM capabilities. Many factories here supply European and American brands.
  • Yiwu (Zhejiang): Known for cost-effective seamless products and high-volume production. Ideal for budget-conscious buyers.
  • Qingdao (Shandong): Growing hub for sports lingerie and activewear, with proximity to northern China textile supply chains.

Understanding MOQ: Minimum Order Quantities

MOQ is one of the biggest challenges for new importers. Here's what to expect:

Order TypeTypical MOQUnit Price RangeLead Time
Existing Style (No Customization)200-500 pcs/style$2-8/pc15-20 days
Custom Design (Your Pattern)500-1,000 pcs/style$3-12/pc25-35 days
Full OEM (Your Brand + Design)1,000-3,000 pcs/style$4-15/pc30-45 days
Premium/Lace Collection300-800 pcs/style$8-25/pc35-50 days

Quality Control Checklist

  • Fabric composition verification (cotton/polyamide/spandex ratios)
  • Color fastness testing (wash and rub tests)
  • Stitch quality inspection (stitches per inch, seam strength)
  • Size accuracy measurement (±1cm tolerance)
  • Elastic durability test (stretch recovery after 100 cycles)
  • Label and packaging compliance (care labels, barcodes)

Shipping & Logistics

Lingerie is lightweight and high-value, making air freight competitive for urgent orders. Sea freight is ideal for bulk shipments. Typical shipping costs from Guangdong to Tbilisi:

  • Air Freight: $4-8/kg, 7-10 days transit
  • Sea Freight (LCL): $80-150/CBM, 25-35 days
  • Express (DHL/FedEx): $12-18/kg, 3-5 days for samples
